name: Parity Harness
description: How one RenderBackend is measured against another (Sources/CoreRender/Parity): ParityTolerance (byte and linear bounds, .standard and .nonSeparable); ParityHarness.compare, which checks two results' sRGB display bytes through CoreRaster's rgba8 and their linear premultiplied Floats over visible pixels and names the worst pixel; the deterministic sample set per RenderOp (seeded buffers plus alpha 0, subnormal alpha, opaque rows and sources off every edge) and rendering a sample on any backend; and golden files (raw rgba8 bytes beside a JSON header), validated as untrusted input.
